text: Make the coding-assistant stop hook continue autonomous work indefinitely
description: Return the documented Stop-hook continuation decision instead of a decorative message. Keep an explicit opt-out for deliberate shutdown.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Makes the existing indefinite continuation behavior portable, explicit, and testable.
The deliberate opt-out is one click away in the UI instead of an MCP prompt in an agent session
A purpose-built session command complements the existing hook controls by establishing the idea-recording workflow at session start.
A per-run log lets the human see what an autonomous run changed in a minute instead of reading git log and idea diffs; if the agent skips lines, the log is useless.
Agents stop asking the human while actionable open ideas exist below the ranking cut. Refuted if a hooked session again confirms a human block while list_ideas shows an actionable open leaf.

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting user acceptance.
